subject: Realtime stream silence — Crestline production incident
messages:
From: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@crestline.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, support@redwoodinference.com
Cc: crestline-support@crestline.io
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Realtime stream silence observed in production: immediate attention required

Alex / Redwood team,

We started seeing a service-affecting problem around 09:07 PDT in our production tenant. Live assistant sessions intermittently go silent for 8–20s between tokens; some requests never return a chunk and time out on our side. Symptoms:
- P50/P95 latency has jumped (~3x), p99 sits above 8s for token emission.
- Several 503/502 spikes correlated with silence windows.
- Overall throughput for active sessions dropped ~40% over the last 5 minutes.

Attached are a short HAR/ws trace (ws_trace_0912.har) and logs.zip with the client-side captures. This is impacting our customer-facing chat; we have users in live demos right now. Please treat as Sev-1 and advise ETA for mitigation.

Rajesh
VP Product
Crestline Analytics

Attachments: crestline_logs_0912.zip, ws_trace_0912.har

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@crestline.io>, crestline-support@crestline.io
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime stream silence observed in production: immediate attention required

Rajesh — thanks for the report and the traces. We’re escalating immediately.

Action so far (minutes):
- I’ve opened INC-7832 and started a war room (link below).
- Looping in Dev (SRE) for infra triage and Hannah for engineering lead.
- Asking David to join for cs/exec notifications.

Dev, Hannah — please prioritize a quick triage: collect the last 10 minutes of proxy/nginx and streaming runtime traces for tenant crestline, and share Datadog links. Rajesh, we’ll keep this thread for status; I’ll also post into the war room.

Proposed short call: in 5 minutes (09:21 PDT) to confirm initial hypothesis and next steps — will post Zoom link.

Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Related: https://datadog.redwoodinference.com/dashboards/streaming/tenant-crestline
War room: https://zoom.us/j/999888777

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime stream silence observed in production: immediate attention required

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 09:16 AM Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Dev, Hannah — please prioritize a quick triage: collect the last 10 minutes of proxy/nginx and streaming runtime traces for tenant crestline, and share Datadog links.

Initial triage (first-pass):
- Observed repeated downstream backpressure at our public edge proxy for requests to tenant=crestline. Proxy worker queue depth spiked and we saw a surge of TCP RSTs and keepalive timeouts at ~09:06–09:10.
- Nginx access logs show chunked-transfer streams where the server emitted the first chunks then stalled (no further chunks) while the backend was still OK — suggests buffering or proxy write stalls rather than model runtime crash.
- Datadog traces indicate elevated socket write latency and occasional 502s from upstream when the proxy dropped the connection mid-stream.

Immediate mitigations I can push now (low-risk):
1) Remap crestline traffic to a less-loaded proxy pool (rollout 2 mins) — reduces contention quickly.
2) Force bypass of chunked buffering at the edge for that tenant (temporary) — forces direct passthrough of chunks.
3) Short-term: reduce max concurrent sessions allowed for the tenant from 200 -> 120 to shed load.

I’m starting the remap now as a canary to one host and will report back within 6–8 minutes. Patching nginx proxy buffer sizes and per-connection timeouts should be next (requires config rollout).

Datadog snapshot: https://datadog.redwoodinference.com/dashboards/snapshot/crestline-0912
Command snippets I ran:
- curl -H 'Tenant: crestline' https://edge01.redwoodinference.com/health
- sudo tail -n 500 /var/log/nginx/edge01.access | grep crestline

Dev
SRE Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@crestline.io>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: crestline-support@crestline.io
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime stream silence observed in production: immediate attention required

Thanks for the quick response. We captured the same behavior on our side — p99 token emission pauses and a handful of 502s.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether this is an edge/proxy buffering issue vs. downstream model stall? Our internal engineers see model CPU stable during the incidents.
- If you do a remap, please share the expected rollback plan and estimated time to restore normal throughput.

We need ETA for a fix and whether this will be visible to our end-users in the next 15–30 minutes. This is affecting an ongoing sales demo — we need to triage fast.

Rajesh

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec brief: Crestline production degradation — ask for rapid exec sync

David / Vanessa — FYI and urgent ask to bring this to exec attention. Summary for the board / customer execs:
- Impact: ongoing token-emission stalls for Crestline tenant producing user-facing silence windows; throughput down ~40%; error rate spike (502/503) in 09:06–09:12 window.
- Hypothesis: edge proxy write/keepalive/backpressure causing chunked transfer stalls; backend model instances are not OOM nor showing CPU saturation.
- Business risk: customer-visible demo failures and potential churn if not restored quickly. Crestline is a mid-enterprise strategic account (DP-4381).

Proposed immediate mitigations (what engineering is executing now):
1) Traffic remap to a less-loaded proxy pool (in flight).
2) Bypass chunked buffering for the tenant to avoid intermediate buffering.
3) If remap fails, route crestline to a dedicated pod pool (requires higher privilege change but will remove noisy-neighbor risk).

Ask for exec decisions:
- Approve emergency route-to-dedicated-pool if remap does not restore within 20 minutes.
- Prepare a customer-facing timeline and an offer for a credit if SLA impacted.

I’ll keep you posted — will post a short slide for external execs if we need to escalate.

Hannah Schmitt
Engineering Manager, Real-time Systems
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@crestline.io>, crestline-support@crestline.io
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime stream silence observed in production: immediate attention required

Rajesh — update and next steps: after remapping two edge hosts and temporarily disabling chunked buffering at the edge for crestline, we observed immediate reduction in token-silence windows and throughput recovered to ~90% of pre-incident levels. Full timeline:
- 09:21: canary remap to edge02 (reduced error spikes on that host).
- 09:27: disabled chunked buffering on edge02 for tenant crestline (passthrough). Emission pauses reduced significantly within 90s.
- 09:40: completed rollout to the rest of the proxy pool for the tenant.

Current status: degraded -> partial recovery. We are continuing to monitor with an SRE patch to proxy timeouts and buffer sizes — will push a permanent config change and plan a follow-up maintenance window to fully stabilize. INC-7832 has the details (https://jira.redwoodinference.com/browse/INC-7832).

Customer ask re: credit / SLA: Hannah / David / Vanessa — can you coordinate CS/finance response and seat a follow-up with their execs? Rajesh, we’ll commit to a postmortem within 48 hours and an action plan that includes a permanent hardening (proxy pool isolation or dedicated pod option).

Attachments: incident_timeline.png
War room recording: https://zoom.us/recording/abc123

Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
